candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment 'betLimit = amount;' so the bet limit never changes.
Replace the assignment with 'betLimit = amount + 1;' so the stored bet limit is off by one.
Replace the assignment with 'betLimit += amount;' so the amount is added to the existing limit instead of replacing it.
Invert the owner check to 'require(msg.sender != owner);' so only non-owners can change the bet limit.
Assign betLimit to difficulty instead of amount, so difficulty is not updated to the requested value.
Add amount to difficulty rather than assigning it, so difficulty accumulates values.
Delete the assignment so difficulty is never changed by AdjustDifficulty.
Set difficulty to block.number instead of the amount parameter.
Remove the owner check so any caller can adjust the difficulty.
Invert the owner check so only non-owners (and not the owner) can adjust the difficulty.
Delete the statement `openToPublic = true;` so calling OpenToThePublic never flips the flag, leaving isOpenToPublic-guarded functions reverting.
Replace `openToPublic = true;` with `openToPublic = false;` so the flag stays false (and can never become true via this function).
Remove the `require(msg.sender == owner);` check in the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can invoke OpenToThePublic and flip openToPublic.
Delete the assignment 'betLimit = amount;' so calling AdjustBetAmounts no longer changes betLimit.
Replace 'betLimit = amount;' with 'betLimit = amount / 2;' so betLimit is set to half the requested amount.
Replace the event argument 'betLimit' with 'amount' so the emitted BetLimitChanged event carries the raw input instead of the updated state value.
